faq_heading: Homes near Topham Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Topham Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Topham Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Topham Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Topham Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 90 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,285,000, townhomes $820,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Topham Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Topham Elementary the median was 20 days on the market, closing at 97.7% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 90 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Topham Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are James Kennedy Elementary (0.6 km west), des Voyageurs (0.8 km south) and West Langley Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

Topham Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 21555 91 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Topham Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Topham Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Topham Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Topham Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 90 homes sold within 1 km of Topham Elementary: 53 houses and 37 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,285,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Topham Elementary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Topham Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 2 other, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 1 independent). The closest is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: James Kennedy Elementary (0.6 km west), des Voyageurs (0.8 km south), West Langley Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Alex Hope Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Gordon Greenwood Elementary (2.0 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.6 km west of Topham Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Topham Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from Topham Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Topham Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Topham Elementary was $1,285,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at James Kennedy Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km west of Topham Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
